title: News
description: News article or news story with headline, content, source attribution, geographic and language information. Used for news websites, RSS feeds, and news aggregation platforms.

id.description: Unique identifier for the news article

headline.description: Main headline or title of the news story

summary.description: Brief summary or lead paragraph of the news article

content.description: Full news article content and body text

author.description: Full name of the journalist or reporter who wrote the article

source.description: News organization or publication that published the article (e.g., BBC, CNN, Reuters)

category.description: News category (e.g., Politics, Business, Technology, Sports, World)

country.description: Country where the news story originates or is most relevant

language.description: Language code of the article content (e.g., en, es, fr)

tags.description: Array of topic tags for categorization and search

image.description: URL to the featured image or photo accompanying the news article

url.description: Original URL where the news article was published

published_at.description: Timestamp when the news article was published
